content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators in Kenya struggle with payment gateways that impose geographical restrictions, high fees, and bureaucratic hurdles. The infrastructure we propose leverages technologies that are inherently global and decentralized. By utilizing blockchain-based payment solutions, you can bypass the issues associated with traditional payment providers. This infrastructure allows you to maintain complete ownership of your ecommerce environment, meaning you are not at the mercy of platform policies or changes. You gain the ability to design, deploy, and manage your online store without being shackled by conventional payment paradigms. This not only empowers you to act swiftly but also provides a better experience for your customers who often face similar restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, you need a few essential components that will form the backbone of your digital commerce stack. First, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides the foundation for your website. Next, consider utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, which are crucial for handling interactions between users and your store. You’ll also want a database solution, such as Supabase or even Google Sheets, for managing your orders and customer data. Furthermore, choose a file delivery service, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure your ebooks can be delivered immediately upon purchase. Finally, integrating a payment processor like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-first-principles-5|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]] will allow you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

After determining your necessary components, it’s time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by deploying your website on your chosen hosting platform. For instance, if using Cloudflare Pages, simply push your static site files to your repository. Next, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle incoming orders and initiate the payment verification process. Once a payment is confirmed, integrate the delivery mechanism via services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation. It’s essential to test this pipeline thoroughly to ensure that every component works seamlessly together before going live.
Build your ecommerce store without restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, you'll prepare to go live. First, double-check that all links function correctly, and your payment gateway is properly configured. Announce your ebook for sale on social media platforms, and engage with your audience to generate interest. Once you receive your first order, monitor the transaction process closely. Ensure that the payment is verified through NOWPayments and watch as your delivery system triggers the ebook dispatch. This initial transaction will serve as a critical test for your entire setup. Any issues should be addressed immediately to ensure a smooth operation moving forward. After successfully processing your first sale, you will have a solid foundation to build upon.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your ebook selling infrastructure is operational and successfully processing transactions, it’s time to consider scaling. Start by analyzing sales data to identify which ebooks are most popular and optimize your marketing efforts around them. You may want to expand your product offerings beyond ebooks, such as courses or templates, to attract a broader audience. Additionally, consider implementing advanced marketing strategies like email campaigns or social media promotions targeted at your demographic. The scalability of your infrastructure allows you to add more products and increase market reach without needing to rebuild from scratch. This flexibility is a major advantage over traditional platforms that often impose hard limits on growth.

By using blockchain-based solutions and cloud services like Cloudflare, you remove geographical barriers and ensure full ownership of your store. This setup allows you to sell ebooks efficiently without relying on restricted platforms.
